title: Idaho Film Society

services.name: Event Rentals
services.desc: The IFS Station is a newly restored, two screen arthouse theater and 10,000 sq ft creative hub operated by the Idaho Film Society in the heart of downtown Boise. Just steps from the Capitol and a short walk to some of the city's best restaurants, our venue features a flexible event space, and a curated film lounge perfect for screenings, receptions, performances, workshops, and more. From red carpet premieres and private screenings to corporate mixers, gallery shows, and film production basecamp, The Station offers a one-of-a-kind historic setting with modern amenities for every kind of event. Flexible Lobby / Lounge Area for Panels, Music, and Receptions, with 180 person capacity The
